eligibility.quote: This is initial output of 'rostopic echo tf'. I can see a twisted rotation.
eligibility.reason: E1/E4: a launch reproducer, visualization report and echoed transform establish wrong published data. E2: the erroneous transform crosses the node-to-viewer boundary; an internal implementation edit does not make this internal-only. E3: the transform and point-cloud outputs feed a visualization consumer in PAIR.

failed_conditions.quote: It looks wrong tf between map and camera_link.
failed_conditions.reason: The source explicitly identifies a wrong map/camera transform and shows the emitted /tf data. frame_mismatch is supportable as a coordinate-frame relationship error, not a claim that the literal frame names differ.

failed_conditions.quote:
In the orb coordinate system, a flat plane is x-z and top is -y.
In the ros coordinate system, a flat plane is x-y and top is z.
failed_conditions.reason: The fix author directly describes incompatible axis conventions and conversion on both camera and map sides. This supports representation_convention on the published transform without relying on the paper's paraphrase.

supporting_evidence.quote: +  //Transform from orb coordinate system to ros coordinate system on map coordinates

missed_conditions.quote: I was using wrong yaml file in which the DepthMapFactor was 5000 . When I use RealSenseD435RGBD.yaml, distance issue is gone.
missed_conditions.reason: The same selected node-to-rviz composition also exposes an incorrectly scaled published map. S1 requires all documented failed interactions within that composition, even when their causes are independent. The specification already inventories this map_points output, so relegating the distance failure to an unrelated note omits a condition. Use other for the confirmed calibration/scale error: the source does not establish competing declared units that would require unit_mismatch. Changing the numeric DepthMapFactor is not mere deployment name binding.

supporting_evidence.quote: But, the distance looks different between the map and camera view(ex: /camera/depth_registered/points) on rviz. Why?

loudness.quote: I can see the point cloud of the map above the camera, initially.
loudness.reason: The report detects wrong spatial output visually and through rostopic echo, with no build/connection/activation diagnostic for this mismatch. The added map-scale condition is likewise observed visually.

detection_stage.quote: This is initial output of 'rostopic echo tf'. I can see a twisted rotation.
detection_stage.reason: The evidence is emitted transforms and rendered point clouds during execution.

resolution.quote: The fix proposed by @saoto28 really works.
resolution.reason: There is positive success evidence for the transform correction, but no identified rviz revision, so recommended remains the appropriate strict S1 status. A complete resolution description must also retain the separately documented DepthMapFactor correction for the missed map-scale condition.

notes: The two listed transform classes describe overlapping frame/convention aspects, not evidence of two separate incidents. The distance-scale report is a distinct failed output within the same inventoried publisher/viewer composition and is therefore added. The proposed class other avoids inventing an undocumented unit declaration. The patch's rewritten translation expression alone is not treated as a third independent sign-error condition; the old implementation also applies additional axis/sign matrices, so comparing only its initial R^T*t line would be misleading.
